lines.en: I walk on four legs. Steady.

lines.zh: 我胸前的标记，是个 X。
lines.en: The mark on my chest is an X.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边嗅着林子。
lines.en: I walk and sniff the wood.
My muscles are taut. Ready to run.
I step around roots without breaking stride.
I reach the treeline and pause.
My claws land solid.
My tail swings as I walk.
I know this wood.
My ears keep moving as I walk.
I keep close so you don't get lost.
Step by step. Never slowing.
I sit with my forelegs braced.

lines.zh: 我把爪子插进土里，磨一磨。
lines.en: I dig my claws into the soil to sharpen.

lines.zh: 我在等，等林子里有动静。
lines.en: I wait for the wood to stir.

lines.zh: X 标记随着呼吸起伏。
lines.en: The X on my chest rises and falls.

lines.zh: 我不用吃太多，可我要吃肉。
lines.en: I don't need much. But I need meat.
I lift my head and read the wind.

lines.zh: 这一带很静，我放松一点。
lines.en: Quiet here. I ease a little.
An X-shaped plate on my chest.
I lie down with my chest against the ground.
I wait for your order.
My teeth show a little.
My claws grind against stone.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我身上的毛就动。
lines.en: The wind stirs my coat.
I'm strong, but I don't act rashly.
I sit and wait for a direction.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，跟你平视。
lines.en: I raise my head to your eye level.

lines.zh: 你身上没有危险的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell dangerous.
I step forward, then stop.
Claws retracted. Don't be afraid.

lines.zh: 我胸前这块甲，替我挡过不少。
lines.en: The plate on my chest has taken many blows.
Want to ride? I can carry you.
I lower my head and nudge your hand.
I stand like this, waiting.
I understand a little of what you say.
My fangs are sheathed where you cannot see.

lines.zh: 你的脚步往哪，我的头就转向哪。
lines.en: Wherever you step, my head turns.

lines.zh: X 形的光，照着你的眼睛。
lines.en: An X of light rests on your eyes.
I give my tail one swing.

lines.zh: 你的手放在我肩上，我不动。
lines.en: Your hand on my shoulder, I hold still.

lines.zh: 我朝林子那边抬了抬头。
lines.en: I lift my head toward the wood.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，低吼了一声。
lines.en: I step back and growl.
XV-mon's shoulder took a hit.
A line cut through my coat.
I don't yield. I can still fight.

lines.zh: 我把伤处护住，站了起来。
lines.en: I guard the wound and rise.

lines.zh: XV兽的爪在地上刮出一道白痕。
lines.en: XV-mon's claws gouge a white line in the ground.

lines.zh: 我的爪在地上刮出一道。
lines.en: My claws left a groove.
A blow landed on my ribs.

lines.zh: 我喘得很响，可我还站着。
lines.en: I pant loudly. Still standing.
The deeper the wound, the harder I push.
That smell of blood — I have been hungry a while.
I lean in and sniff.
I swallow the whole piece in one go.
One bite. Not enough.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，够不着那块肉。
lines.en: I stretch my neck but cannot reach the meat.
I lower my head slowly. No snatching.
Blood still hangs from my chin.
This smells like the wood.
You give it; I'll take it.
Once I've eaten, my strength returns.

lines.zh: 这个味道，能勾起我的胃口。
lines.en: That smell stirs my appetite.
An X mark is carved on my horn.
I stay still and you bounce off.
My legs hold. Can't be shoved.
I shoulder you aside.
A whole patch of grass went down.
I dislike my tail being stepped on.
I settle and lower my weight.
That knock will numb your hand.
I back a block and wait.
I lift a leg and step over you.
My hind leg nearly stepped on you.
My kind are seldom met.

lines.zh: 我把头靠过去，它也靠过来。
lines.en: I lean my head over; it leans back.
Two side by side. Well matched.
It's sniffing my chest.
Neither speaks. Only breathing.
Enough wood here for us to run.
We run a stretch and stop together.
At dawn we part.
Its tail brushed my shoulder.
No one else tonight.
I sling it over my back.
Edible. I'll keep it.
This iron is hard on my teeth.

lines.zh: 我用爪子按住它，姿势没变。
lines.en: I pin it with a claw, my stance unchanged.

lines.zh: 这东西从我的爪间滑掉了。
lines.en: It slipped out from between my claws.
I set it by your feet and step back.
It rolled behind a root.

lines.zh: 这块木头，我只咬了一口。
lines.en: I took one bite of this wood.
This should go back with us.
I carry it a stretch.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我压低身子。
lines.en: Something moved. I drop low.
I dig my claws in.

lines.zh: 这条边界，我从这头走到那头。
lines.en: This boundary, I walk from end to end.
Every muscle is taut.
Step by step, without a sound.
I swing across and block the path.

lines.zh: 我的四条腿一起往下沉。
lines.en: My four legs sink as one.

lines.zh: 我胸前的 X 标记绷紧，准备好了。
lines.en: The X on my chest tightens; I am ready.
One push of the X armor and I advance.
My tail stretches straight behind me.
I decide things in this wood.

lines.zh: 我横在你前面，爪子扣地。
lines.en: I cut in front of you, claws dug in.
I face it. Never veering.
It goes left; I turn.
Step by step, closing in.

lines.zh: 两格半的成熟体，腿很稳。
lines.en: Two and a half blocks, and steady on these legs.

lines.zh: 我的视线锁在它肩胛上。
lines.en: My eyes lock on its shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 交叉形的攻击，从我胸口发出。
lines.en: A crossed strike leaves my chest.
I know this wood. No side paths.
Wind favors me.
One block closer and I can leap.
I land my claws without a sound.
Stay behind me. Don't step up.
My hind legs kick off; I move.
The X-Attack starts at my claws.

lines.zh: 这一爪从它的肩上刮下去。
lines.en: This claw rakes down from its shoulder.
That knocked it back.
There's light on my claws.
My tail sweeps and trips it.
Afterward I return to guard you.
That was eight tenths of my strength.

lines.zh: X 形的爪痕留在它侧肋。
lines.en: An X-shaped claw mark on its flank.
My claws stop short of its throat.
Fur is still caught in my mouth.
I used only half my bite.
I shake the dirt off my claws and go again.

lines.zh: 我从林子里走出来，很低。
lines.en: I come out of the wood. Low.

lines.zh: 我先伸了个懒腰，爪子张开。
lines.en: I stretch, claws spreading.
Thicker trees than I expected.

lines.zh: 我把头转了一圈，记下地形。
lines.en: I turn my head once, memorizing the ground.

lines.zh: 我身上的毛，还带着寒气。
lines.en: My coat still carries a chill.

lines.zh: 我把爪子从落叶里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull my claws out of the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 这一片林子，没有别的兽。
lines.en: No other beasts in this wood.

lines.zh: 我胸口有个 X 形的甲。
lines.en: An X-shaped plate guards my chest.
I raise my head. Meat.
I'm set, muscles taut.
Strong as I am, I walk steady.
I'm ready to run at any moment.

lines.zh: 火烧到毛上，我甩了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my coat; I shake it twice.
I fall and my legs buckle.
Soaked, I thrash upward.
The blast flips me onto the ground.

lines.zh: 东西扎进后腿，跑起来疼。
lines.en: It's in my hind leg. Running hurts.
Light binds me and my claws won't lift.

lines.zh: 几天没吃到肉，力气没了。
lines.en: Days without meat. My strength is gone.
Lightning strikes and I go numb.

lines.zh: 我四爪乱划，什么也抓不住。
lines.en: My four paws claw at nothing.
